-- Adicionar colunas SNMP ao fm_rack_equipment (se não existirem)
ALTER TABLE fm_rack_equipment 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS snmp_enabled TINYINT DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS snmp_host VARCHAR(64),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS snmp_port INT DEFAULT 161,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS snmp_community VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'public',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS snmp_version ENUM('1','2c','3') DEFAULT '2c',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS snmp_oid_profile VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'generic';

-- Modificar o enum type para incluir rectifier e inverter
ALTER TABLE fm_rack_equipment MODIFY COLUMN type ENUM('olt','dgo','switch','patch_panel','server','nobreak','pdu','router','firewall','rectifier','inverter','other') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other';

-- Criar tabela de métricas de energia SNMP
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fm_snmp_energy_metrics (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  equipment_id INT NOT NULL,
  dc_voltage_v FLOAT,
  ac_input_voltage_v FLOAT,
  ac_output_voltage_v FLOAT,
  total_current_a FLOAT,
  load_percent FLOAT,
  temperature_c FLOAT,
  battery_voltage_v FLOAT,
  battery_current_a FLOAT,
  battery_percent FLOAT,
  battery_status TINYINT DEFAULT 0,
  alarm_flags INT DEFAULT 0,
  alarm_description TEXT,
  rectifier_modules JSON,
  raw_data JSON,
  collected_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_equipment_id (equipment_id),
  INDEX idx_collected_at (collected_at)
);

-- Criar tabela de perfis OID SNMP
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fm_snmp_oid_profiles (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  profile_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  manufacturer VARCHAR(64),
  model VARCHAR(128),
  eq_type ENUM('rectifier','inverter','ups','switch','olt','other') DEFAULT 'other',
  oid_dc_voltage VARCHAR(128),
  oid_total_current VARCHAR(128),
  oid_temperature VARCHAR(128),
  oid_battery_voltage VARCHAR(128),
  oid_battery_current VARCHAR(128),
  oid_battery_percent VARCHAR(128),
  oid_load_percent VARCHAR(128),
  oid_alarms VARCHAR(128),
  oid_ac_input_voltage VARCHAR(128),
  oid_ac_output_voltage VARCHAR(128),
  scale_dc_voltage FLOAT DEFAULT 1.0,
  scale_current FLOAT DEFAULT 1.0,
  scale_temperature FLOAT DEFAULT 1.0,
  scale_battery_voltage FLOAT DEFAULT 1.0,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
